mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (e.g., 3-month rolling growth > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within one month signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary policy in response to persistent inflation, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown, which precedes economic contraction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, which signals potential economic weakness and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month AND RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within one month signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods when HOUST is rising (e.g., 3-month rolling growth > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
